statement: The owner accepted E27 as the new baseline after reviewing the standard suites, the same-day LAN control, the interference phase and the four-simultaneous-32K diagnostic.
accepted_trade_off: Requests that arrive while others decode wait longer for their first token (C4 per-stream TTFT +35% against the same-day control; a long context arriving next to decoding agents +15-37%), in exchange for running agents decoding 3-5x faster during another request's long cold prefill.
follow_up: E27b: apply the cadence only to prefills with at least 2,048 remaining tokens.
